notes.title: Обновление 0.46
notes.content:
[b]Dear players! [/b]

We’ve prepared a small but useful update to make your experience in "Moth Cry" even more comfortable!

[list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930997/0d693988937a3cd7973ca336af8c2f80cbb1343b.png[/img]
[*] A new button has been added to the interface – now you can quickly jump to the nearest story choice. This feature is available from the first chapter of each of the three storylines.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930997/425af65191a7f50f1cd342b865c4b39605020d9f.png[/img]
[*] Text skipping has been improved – you can now quickly move forward by simply pressing the "Right" key on your keyboard.

[*]  Minor bugs have been fixed, and game resources have been optimized, reducing the overall game size.
[/list]

Thank you for playing "Moth Cry" and for supporting us with your feedback!

notes.title: Demo of Moth Cry is available for download!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

We’ve created a demo version of the visual novel Moth Cry for those who want to explore the game before purchasing.

The demo includes:

[list]
[*] The first chapter of the first story;
[*] The first chapter of the second story;
[*] The first chapter of the third story.
[/list]

If you enjoy the demo, you can continue your journey in the Early Access version, which offers even more chapters and plot twists. Please note that the Early Access version is not yet complete, and we’re actively working on its development.

[b]Enjoy the game! [/b]We look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Update 0.44
notes.content:
[b]Dear players,[/b]

We are excited to share some great news with you:

 [list]
[*]  The first chapter of the second storyline has been added and is now available in early access! It includes a brand-new minigame called "My Mother Told Me."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930997/97ea8eb98e8e9e4c65f689a9992148972de6fd3f.png[/img]

[*] Four new achievements are waiting for you! Unlock them by exploring different storylines and branching paths.

[*]  All three storylines now feature mini-games, making your experience even more interactive and engaging!

[*]  All three storylines are now available in early access:
[/list] [olist]
[*] The first storyline: Includes both the first and second chapters.
[*] The second storyline: Currently includes only the first chapter.
[*] The third storyline: Includes both the first and second chapters.
[/olist]

Check out the update to enjoy the new features and continue your journey in the world of "Moth Cry."

Thank you for staying with us and supporting our project!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 0.41
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce Update 0.41 for the visual novel Moth Cry!

What’s new:

[list]
[*] New Mini-Game: “Dodgeball”!
Dive into this exciting mini-game while playing through the second story. We hope it brings even more fun and dynamism to your gaming experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930997/57cce8f86d1c4fe38e0e8f8a181eabdffac65195.png[/img]

[*] Bug Fixes.
We’ve addressed several minor issues to ensure a smoother journey through the world of Moth Cry.
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support and interest in our project. As always, we welcome your feedback—it’s invaluable in helping us improve the game!

Try out the update, share your thoughts, and don’t forget to leave a review. Enjoy the game!

Best regards,
The Harbinger Arts Development Team

notes.title: Moth Cry | Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Dear players,[/h2][/b]
[b][h3]We’re thrilled to announce that the visual novel Moth Cry is now available in Early Access![/h3][/b]
Currently, the game includes:

[list][*]Two stories out of the three planned. [*] Two chapters in each story. [*] Multiple branching paths:
         -  3 choices in the first story.  
- 5 choices in the second story. [/list]   
[b]Every decision you make shapes the narrative, offering a unique experience with each playthrough.[/b], 
Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us and will help make Moth Cry even better.

Thank you for your support and interest in our project! Immerse yourself in a world of mystery and emotions today.

[b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2886110/Moth_Cry/]Play [/url][/h3][/b]
The [b]Harbinger Arts[/b] Development Team
